title: Agent Type Entry
description: Schema defining the structure of an AI agent type entry in the Agent Asset Registry

id.description: Unique identifier for the agent type, in kebab-case

name.description: Human-readable name of the agent type

description.description: Detailed description of the agent type, its purpose, and typical use cases

category.description: Category grouping for the agent type. Must match the directory under registry/agent_types/

vendor.description: Identifier referencing a vendor definition in registry/vendors/

capabilities.description: List of capabilities or functions the agent type can perform

risk_profile.description: Assessed risk level of the agent type based on autonomy, access, and potential impact

known_behaviors.description: Documented behavioral patterns observed in this agent type

pattern.description: Short label or identifier for the behavior pattern

description.description: Detailed description of the behavior pattern, including triggers and outcomes

detection_signatures.description: List of detection signatures that can identify this agent type in runtime environments

first_seen.description: Date when this agent type was first observed in the wild or documented

references.description: URL references to documentation, research papers, vendor pages, or related resources

allOf.description: Ensure category matches the subdirectory structure convention

capabilities.description: General-purpose agents should typically have broad capability sets

allOf.description: High and critical risk profiles must include known_behaviors
